help.title: Ubufasha
help.subtitle: Amasakaza asubiza ibibazo umunyamuryango mushya atsibaza.
help.a1: Fungura Gutanga umusanzu, Reba amafaranga afungiyeho umusanzu wa buri kwezi, hanyuma wemeza ukoreshe PIN. Umurongo urandikwa mu gitabo cy’ibigenzura.
help.a2: Umunyamuryango asaba ugukurura. Kwemeza 75% by’itsinda birasabwa, harimo umunyamuryango usanzwe umwe.
help.a3: Uruziga rugena umunyamuryango uzabaha amafaranga buri gice. Abayobozi bashobora guhindura uragenekereje isakarimu.
help.a4: Abanyamuryango b’itsinda ryawe gusa ni bo bashobora kubona amakuru y’itsinda. Igitabo cy’ibigenzura gisiga gusa kuri bose.
help.a5: Buri gukora gusura amafaranga gusubiramo kugenzura PIN yawe, nubwo uri mukuru wese.
help.q6: Bigenze iki niba nibibuka PIN yawe?
help.a6: Nta buryo bwo kwiruka kugenzura PIN. Vugana n’abayobozi b’itsinda ryawe kugira ngo bakongere usubire inyirizanyo.
help.a7: Yego, Ibimina ntibafite amafaranga yawe. Ibirandika icyo itsinda ryemeye, ariko ntishyura cyangwa kohereza amafaranga mu gice kigezweho.
help.a8: Fungura Igenamiterere, hanyuma ubandike Siba konti. Uri weza Perezida, mbashireho undi Perezida mbere yo gukomeza.
help.contactBody: Vugana n’abayobozi b’itsinda ryawe, cyangwa uhamagere nomero y’ubugira uri hasi.
